versions.subject: Merge PR #5620 from @swachchhanda000 - Commonvault vulnerabilities
versions.detection:
# Add more suspicious processes or paths or extensions as needed
selection_susp_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\dotnet.exe'
        - '\w3wp.exe'
        - '\java.exe'
selection_servers:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '\apache'
        - '\tomcat'
selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\webapps\ROOT\'
selection_susp_extensions:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.jsp'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\dotnet.exe", "*\\w3wp.exe", "*\\java.exe") TargetFilename IN ("*\\apache*", "*\\tomcat*") TargetFilename="*\\webapps\\ROOT\\*" TargetFilename="*.jsp"
